impact_summary: IPPAN reported 13 hydropower projects with a combined 150 MW affected by floods and landslides in Sankhuwasabha, Taplejung and Panchthar.
source_title: ShareSansar, 'Flood Damaged 13 Hydropower Projects of 150 MW Collective Capacity: IPPAN' (19 Jun 2023)
notes: Tally as reported; the article names 14 projects against a headline count of 13 and includes a 125 MW 'Kabeli B' entry not reconciled here. Republica (27 Jan 2024) gives 11 projects / 107.54 MW for 13-22 June 2023 and a later IPPAN estimate of more than Rs 8 billion across 31 projects; the counts differ by window and scope. Province: canonical-geography.

affected_asset_name: Super Hewa Khola Hydropower Project (5 MW; under construction)
impact_summary: Under-construction project heavily damaged; workers killed and missing. The project chairman put the loss at Rs 220 million and the rebuilding requirement at Rs 500 million.
source_title: Republica, 'Lack of flood preparedness inflicts severe damage on hydropower projects' (27 Jan 2024)
notes: Damage figure is a developer estimate reported by press, not an audited loss. Republica dates the flood 14 June 2023; other contemporaneous reports describe the night of 17 June. Capacity 5 MW per the IPPAN list (ShareSansar, 19 Jun 2023). Province: canonical-geography.

impact_summary: Generation halted; headworks, access road, switchyard and powerhouse affected per the company disclosure.
source_title: ShareSansar, '14.9 MW Hydropower Project of Panchthar Power Company Halted Due to Flood' (19 Jun 2023)

impact_summary: Two-lake cascade outburst (Upper and Lower Ngole Cho) sent a hyper-concentrated flow more than 80 km down the Thame and Dudh Koshi; the Khumbu hydropower intake was damaged and sediment deposited near the surge tank.
source_title: ICIMOD & NDRRMA (2025) Thame Valley GLOF 2024 - Causes; Impacts and Future Risks
notes: Wiki source page: icimod-ndrrma-thame-glof-2024. Plant capacity, outage and repair cost not given in the source. Province: canonical-geography.

impact_summary: IPPAN reported 15 projects with a combined 1,177 MW halted after the late-September 2024 rains; national output fell from about 3,000 MW to 1,300 MW and NEA switched from exporting over 500 MW to importing about 300 MW from India.
source_title: ShareSansar, 'Floods and Landslides Damage 20 Hydropower Plants, Disrupt Power Supply in Nepal' (30 Sep 2024)
notes: Halted capacity is not damaged capacity. Urja Khabar cites NDRRMA putting damage to 26 hydropower facilities at about Rs 3.018 billion (not separately verified here). Rains began 25-26 September; 27 September used as the event date.

impact_summary: Desander ponds, box culverts and surface control rooms damaged and a 220 kV evacuation tower destroyed; generation suspended for 88 days. Physical damage NPR 1.79 billion plus NPR 1.43 billion business-interruption loss.
source_title: ShareSansar (30 Sep 2024) lists the plant among damaged projects; figures from wiki source ukhl-financials-generation-fy2079-82 (UKHL financials compilation)
notes: Outage days and NPR figures come from a research compilation of UKHL accounts / NEA / ICRA disclosures, not a single primary document; insurance claim range NPR 2.0-3.22 billion is unsettled. Province: canonical-geography.

impact_summary: Rapid discharge from a supraglacial lake on the Purepu Glacier (Tibet) flooded the Lende/Bhote Koshi-Trishuli corridor; NDRRMA's first situation report lists the Nepal-China Friendship Bridge, parts of the Rasuwagadhi dry port, about 16 km of road and three hydropower plants as affected.
source_title: NDRRMA Rasuwa Glacial Flood Situation Report 1 (10 Jul 2025)
notes: Wiki source page: ndrrma-rasuwa-glacial-flood-sitrep-2025. The sitrep does not name the three plants or give plant-level damage. Province: canonical-geography.

impact_summary: Severe damage to civil, hydromechanical and electromechanical works and suspension of generation; one unit back on partial generation on 6 December 2025 and two-unit generation under dry-season flows from 25 December 2025.
source_title: NEA Engineering Company Annual Report FY 2081/82
notes: Wiki source page: nea-engineering-annual-report-2081-82. outage_days = 8 Jul to 6 Dec 2025 (first-unit partial return) computed from the source dates; full-capacity return not stated. No damage cost in the source. Province: canonical-geography.

impact_summary: Damage to temporary and gantry towers and protective structures; major right-bank scour, left-bank sediment deposition and an estimated channel shift of about 80 m toward the substation.
source_title: NEA Engineering Company Annual Report FY 2081/82
